title: Fleet RLM model-facing Tool contract
scope: This is the model-facing inventory for one Fleet RLM invocation. It records tool names, DSPy argument schemas, result success shapes, composition availability, authority, and public event redaction. It is not an HTTP/OpenAPI contract.
argument_schema_note: Each argument_schema.properties value is the current dspy.Tool.args value. required follows dspy.Tool.format_as_litellm_function_call(): properties with no schema default are required.
result_schema_note: Result schemas describe successful JSON values. Tools may instead raise a closed, sanitized error; schemas permit documented optional failure fields where the host returns them.

entries.name: append_workspace_text
entries.description: Append UTF-8 text immediately into this Session's durable Workspace when incremental state must survive the Run; this durability is independent of Turn Commit.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Session Workspace capability; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds one Session-scoped Workspace filesystem; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: create_artifact
entries.description: Stage generated text, markdown, or JSON as a private Artifact Candidate; it is promoted only by a successful Turn Commit.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the live Daytona capability composition; deterministic private composition deliberately omits Artifact Candidate tools.
entries.authorization_policy: File host owns the current Run, Session, Workspace, and Volume staging scope; generic observed-tool Run authority fails closed after revocation. Promotion is owned by successful Turn Commit.

entries.name: delete_project_path
entries.description: Delete one file or one empty directory immediately under projects/<slug>/; non-empty directories are refused, and a supplied expected_sha256 guards against deleting changed content. This durability is independent of Turn Commit.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Project capability rooted at projects/; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the projects root with validated project-slug paths; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: delete_workspace_path
entries.description: Delete one file or one empty directory immediately from this Session's durable Workspace; non-empty directories are refused, and a supplied expected_sha256 guards against deleting changed content. This durability is independent of Turn Commit.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Session Workspace capability; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds one Session-scoped Workspace filesystem; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: edit_memory
entries.description: Replace one remembered learning in place by id, preserving its id and timestamp; pass category only to recategorize.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Workspace Memory capability; it is omitted from the deterministic private composition.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the current Workspace Memory store; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: edit_project_text
entries.description: Replace exactly one unique occurrence of old with new in one UTF-8 Project file under projects/<slug>/; the edit fails when old is absent or occurs more than once, and a supplied expected_sha256 guards against editing changed content. Read the file first and keep old short and unique. This durability is independent of Turn Commit.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Project capability rooted at projects/; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the projects root with validated project-slug paths; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: edit_workspace_text
entries.description: Replace exactly one unique occurrence of old with new in one UTF-8 Session Workspace file; the edit fails when old is absent or occurs more than once, and a supplied expected_sha256 guards against editing changed content. Read the file first and keep old short and unique. This durability is independent of Turn Commit.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Session Workspace capability; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds one Session-scoped Workspace filesystem; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: fetch_url
entries.description: Fetch one relevant anonymous public HTTPS text URL. The result is a Python value; do not print the complete content. Repeated calls reuse the Session cache.
entries.availability_policy: Composed in live and deterministic test environments. Live uses public HTTPS retrieval plus a Session cache; deterministic tests use a cache-only fetcher that reports unavailable on a miss.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds one Session ID and source store; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: forget
entries.description: Remove exactly one Workspace Memory entry by id when the user asks to forget it.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Workspace Memory capability; it is omitted from the deterministic private composition.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the current Workspace Memory store; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: list_memories
entries.description: List durable Workspace Memory entries (id, timestamp, category, learning) chronologically with bounded pages; pass the previous page's next_cursor as after to continue.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Workspace Memory capability; it is omitted from the deterministic private composition.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the current Workspace Memory store; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: list_project_files
entries.description: List immediate entries under projects/<slug>/ (or the projects root) only when existing durable Project deliverables are relevant; do not explore them for a self-contained request.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Project capability rooted at projects/; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the projects root with validated project-slug paths; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: list_workspace_files
entries.description: List immediate entries in this Session's durable Workspace only when existing durable state is relevant; do not explore it for a self-contained request.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Session Workspace capability; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds one Session-scoped Workspace filesystem; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: llm_query
entries.description: query a sub-LLM (~500K char capacity) for semantic analysis
entries.availability_policy: Built into every native dspy.RLM invocation for the current Root or child invocation; DSPy creates a fresh max_llm_calls counter for that invocation.
entries.authorization_policy: Native DSPy internal capability only. It is not caller-supplied and uses the host-selected Sub LM for the current RLM invocation.

entries.name: llm_query_batched
entries.description: query multiple prompts concurrently (much faster for multiple queries)
entries.availability_policy: Built into every native dspy.RLM invocation for the current Root or child invocation; DSPy creates a fresh max_llm_calls counter for that invocation.
entries.authorization_policy: Native DSPy internal capability only. It is not caller-supplied and uses the host-selected Sub LM for the current RLM invocation.

entries.name: load_skill
entries.description: Load an authorized Skill only when its advertised Skill Card is relevant to the current request. Returns a dictionary with ok, skill_markdown, allowed_tools, and resources on success, or error on failure; allowed_tools are model guidance, not authorization; do not load Skills speculatively.
entries.availability_policy: Composed when the immutable bundled Skill catalog is available; unavailable catalogs omit both Tools, and explicit selections restrict allowed Skill IDs.
entries.authorization_policy: Skill host resolves only catalog Skills permitted for this Turn; resource reads additionally require that Skill to be loaded. allowed_tools is guidance, not authorization.

entries.name: propose_memory
entries.description: Propose one durable cross-session preference, workflow, or project learning for later commit-gated promotion. Use only for stable, non-secret evidence likely to remain useful beyond this Turn; never for temporary task state, raw documents, credentials, or ordinary conversational facts. This does not immediately change Workspace Memory.
entries.availability_policy: Omitted by default. It is a Root-only live capability only when rlm.autonomous_memory_categories is non-empty; native child RLMs never receive it.
entries.authorization_policy: A Run-scoped collector validates the configured category allowlist, limits, and optional supersession target; generic observed-tool Run authority fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: publish_workspace_artifact
entries.description: Stage an existing durable Session Workspace text file as a private Artifact Candidate; it is promoted only by a successful Turn Commit.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the live Daytona capability composition; deterministic private composition deliberately omits Artifact Candidate tools.
entries.authorization_policy: File host owns the current Run, Session, Workspace, and Volume staging scope; generic observed-tool Run authority fails closed after revocation. Promotion is owned by successful Turn Commit.

entries.name: read_attachment
entries.description: Read one immutable authorized Attachment by opaque identity only when its advertised metadata is relevant to the current request.
entries.availability_policy: Composed in live and deterministic environments, even with no attached references; it succeeds only for an attachment prepared for the current Run.
entries.authorization_policy: File host rechecks the current Run attachment reference, staged path, byte size, and checksum; generic observed-tool Run authority also fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: read_curated_input
entries.description: Read bounded canonical curated evaluation input with the supplied capability handle.
entries.availability_policy: Not part of the conversational Turn inventory. It exists only in the strict Daytona optimization evaluator after validated proof/policy, and that evaluator registers no Session, Workspace, Attachment, History, URL, or external Tool.
entries.authorization_policy: The one-use strict evaluator capability validates the exact transaction_id and sha256 captured by its host-side CuratedEvaluationStore; unrelated handles fail closed.

entries.name: read_project_text
entries.description: Read one relevant UTF-8 Project deliverable page with max_chars in 1..10000 using a projects/<slug>/<path> target. Continue with next_cursor until eof.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Project capability rooted at projects/; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the projects root with validated project-slug paths; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: read_session_history
entries.description: Read a bounded page dictionary of older committed messages only when the current request requires prior-turn evidence. Iterate result["messages"]; each message contains role and content; do not read history for self-contained requests.
entries.availability_policy: Always composed for an authorized Turn in every runtime; its immutable binding is the claimed Session History.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds only the claimed Session History; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: read_skill_resource
entries.description: Read one relevant resource from a previously loaded Skill. Returns a dictionary with ok, content, and resource metadata on success, or error on failure.
entries.availability_policy: Composed when the immutable bundled Skill catalog is available; unavailable catalogs omit both Tools, and explicit selections restrict allowed Skill IDs.
entries.authorization_policy: Skill host resolves only catalog Skills permitted for this Turn; resource reads additionally require that Skill to be loaded. allowed_tools is guidance, not authorization.

entries.name: read_workspace_memory
entries.description: Read the latest bounded cross-session Workspace Memory learnings when prior workspace context is relevant to the current request.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Workspace Memory capability; it is omitted from the deterministic private composition.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the current Workspace Memory store; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: read_workspace_text
entries.description: Read one relevant UTF-8 durable Workspace page with max_chars in 1..10000. Continue with next_cursor until eof.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Session Workspace capability; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds one Session-scoped Workspace filesystem; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: remember
entries.description: Record one durable Workspace Memory learning or preference only when the user explicitly requests that it be remembered; returns the new entry's id for later edit or forget.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Workspace Memory capability; it is omitted from the deterministic private composition.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the current Workspace Memory store; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: rlm_query
entries.description: Solve one self-contained bounded semantic subproblem. Pass only selected data, not the complete Turn, history, Attachment, or Workspace. Store the concise answer.
entries.availability_policy: Available only when recursive execution is enabled: Root and native depth-one child RLMs receive it; deeper calls use the Sub-LM fallback.
entries.authorization_policy: The executor checks live Run authority before reservation, child acquisition, and completion; revoked authority fails closed.

entries.name: rlm_query_batched
entries.description: Solve multiple independent bounded subproblems with isolated child RLMs. Inputs and outputs preserve order; use only when every item needs iterative exploration.
entries.availability_policy: Available only when recursive execution is enabled and only on the Root; native children receive rlm_query but not the batched tool.
entries.authorization_policy: The executor checks live Run authority before reservation, child acquisition, and completion; revoked authority fails closed.

entries.name: search_memories
entries.description: Search durable Workspace Memory for an older relevant learning by a bounded query, using deterministic lexical ranking; pass category only to constrain recall.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Workspace Memory capability; it is omitted from the deterministic private composition.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the current Workspace Memory store; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: stat_project_file
entries.description: Read bounded metadata for a relevant durable Project deliverable path under projects/<slug>/.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Project capability rooted at projects/; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the projects root with validated project-slug paths; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: stat_workspace_file
entries.description: Read bounded metadata for a relevant durable Session Workspace path.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Session Workspace capability; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds one Session-scoped Workspace filesystem; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: update_workspace_memory
entries.description: Legacy alias of remember: record one durable Workspace Memory learning or preference only when the user explicitly requests that it be remembered.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Workspace Memory capability; it is omitted from the deterministic private composition.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the current Workspace Memory store; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: write_project_text
entries.description: Write UTF-8 text immediately as a durable deliverable under projects/<slug>/ when the result must stay browsable across Sessions; choose a short repo/task-derived slug and keep scratch in the Session Workspace. This durability is independent of Turn Commit.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Project capability rooted at projects/; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds the projects root with validated project-slug paths; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.

entries.name: write_workspace_text
entries.description: Write UTF-8 text immediately into this Session's durable Workspace when the result must survive the Run; this durability is independent of Turn Commit.
entries.availability_policy: Available only in the Daytona Session Workspace capability; the deterministic private composition declares Workspace unavailable and omits these Tools.
entries.authorization_policy: Host binds one Session-scoped Workspace filesystem; the generic observed-tool Run-authority fence fails closed after revocation.
